enunciado: Implement a recursive fib(n) and an iterative fibIter(n). Show the first 15 terms with the iterative version, compare fib(20) with fibIter(20) and count how many calls the recursive version makes for n = 20.
objetivos: Write a recursion with two calls
See why naive recursion repeats work
pistas: In the iterative version keeping the last two terms is enough.
Use a global variable to count the calls.
